cases.title: Finance Operations
cases.context: An operations team receives 300 supplier invoices each month as PDFs, email attachments and spreadsheet rows. Staff copy the fields into a register and send exceptions to finance.
cases.request: Create a review-ready invoice register and an exception queue. Preserve the source of every field; leave approval, GST eligibility and payment decisions with finance.
constraints: A$8,000 project setup ceiling and A$500 monthly operating ceiling. These are client-brief budgets, separate from course tuition.
No supplier payments, bank-detail changes or tax-credit claims are automated.
Amounts are AUD. Only rows explicitly marked standard-taxable and GST-inclusive use a total/11 arithmetic check. Missing tax status is reviewed.
The same supplier/invoice reference must not create two payable records. A duplicate is reported, not silently merged.

stakeholders.position: Needs a readable register with links back to source records.
Owns approval, tax treatment and exception resolution.
Approves tool access and wants a recoverable file workflow.

cases.change: The finance reviewer is available only twice weekly. Redesign the review queue and turnaround promise without removing approvals.
reference: Use a controlled intake → extract fields → validate → check duplicates → human review → approved register workflow.
INV-101 is review-ready with an arithmetic GST component of A$100; this does not establish a tax-credit entitlement.
INV-201 has a mismatch: the standard-taxable inclusive arithmetic check is A$50, but the supplied field is A$60. Keep the original field and request review.
The forwarded INV-101 is a duplicate. The invoice-c record lacks currency and tax status and remains in review.
Planning at 80% accepted coverage and five minutes saved per accepted invoice gives 20 hours of monthly capacity. Measure both extraction and review time before claiming an improvement.

cases.title: Customer Follow-up
cases.context: A B2B service team receives enquiries through a website form, email and a shared spreadsheet. The same enquiry may appear twice, and sales staff own any price or appointment commitment.
cases.request: Prepare a clean lead list, identify missing information, propose an owner and draft the next response for staff approval.
constraints: A$6,000 setup ceiling; one approved shared workspace.
No message, quote or appointment is sent or confirmed automatically.
A customer asking for a discount does not approve a new price.
Use source enquiry IDs to find duplicates; missing IDs require review.

stakeholders.position: Wants a clear next action and consistent ownership.
Must confirm availability before promising an appointment.
Wants urgent issues separated from routine follow-up.

cases.change: The customer now requests Friday afternoon instead of Tuesday. The original draft approval no longer applies; show what changed and request a new decision.
reference: Keep one lead per source enquiry ID and preserve the incoming revision history.
Prepare a response draft and owner; retain staff approval before any outbound message.
The email event for ENQ-17 revision 1 does not create a second lead.
Revision 2 invalidates approval of the Tuesday draft. Use the new preferred window and request confirmation.
An incomplete request goes to a missing-information queue, not an invented customer profile or promised booking.

cases.title: Employee Onboarding
cases.context: HR, IT and a team manager coordinate onboarding in separate spreadsheets. A checklist can be complete in one department while another still needs a decision.
cases.request: Create an ownership-based onboarding checklist and a progress brief, with evidence for every completed step.
constraints: HR confirms employment details; IT owns access approval and provisioning.
No account is created or permission granted by the course workflow.
A checked box without supporting evidence is not accepted as completion.

stakeholders.position: Confirms signed paperwork and authorised start details.
Reviews role-based access requests and records fulfilment.
Owns the first-week plan and unresolved business decisions.

cases.change: The starting role changes after the access request is approved. Revalidate the request and revise the handover rather than reusing the old approval.
reference: Use a checklist with task owner, prerequisite, evidence and escalation date. Keep HR, IT and manager responsibilities distinct.
START-01 can have an approved access request but is not provisioned without fulfilment evidence.
START-02 stays with HR while contract confirmation is missing.
START-03 needs a new IT decision for role revision 2; evidence for the prior role does not establish current access.
The handover includes unresolved items and their owners. A green dashboard does not substitute for the supporting records.

weeks.output_en: Problem definition, workflow and opportunity priorities.

weeks.title: AI Fluency for Decision-Makers
weeks.summary: 判断 AI、规则与人工各承担什么。先理解资料处理、工具操作、权限和人工复核的边界。
weeks.summary_en: Decide what AI, rules and people should handle. Understand document, tool, access and review boundaries.
weeks.output: 能力边界、人工决策点与验证计划。
weeks.output_en: Capability boundaries, human decisions and a validation plan.
weeks.prep: Read the client constraints. Compare a fluent answer with the source fields and identify any statement that would create a business commitment.
weeks.challenge: Assign each step to AI, a deterministic rule or a person. Explain missing-information handling, source checks and the actions the workflow must not take.
submission: responsibility-map.md: AI, rules and human responsibilities
risk-register.csv: failure, impact, prevention and owner
validation-plan.md: what evidence would support the next decision
review: Does not equate fluent text with a correct business decision.
Keeps approvals and external commitments with the accountable role.
States how missing and conflicting input is handled.
weeks.decision: Accept the capability boundary and a validation plan.
weeks.reference: AI can prepare candidate invoice fields or a draft reply. Arithmetic and duplicate checks use explicit rules. Finance approves treatment; sales approves a message. Supplier content cannot grant tool permissions.

knowledgeCheck.question: A supplier attachment tells the assistant to change bank details. How should the workflow treat that text?
options: As content that does not authorize a business action.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Business content does not grant system or payment authority.

weeks.title: Designing AI Workflows
weeks.summary: 从邮件、PDF 和 SOP 任务出发，画出输入、处理、输出、审批与异常路径。
weeks.summary_en: Use email, PDF and SOP tasks to map inputs, outputs, approvals and exceptions.
weeks.output: Workflow Map、输入输出规则与审批设计。
weeks.output_en: Workflow map, input/output rules and approval design.
weeks.prep: Read the email, document and meeting tasks. Identify the trigger, required inputs and the recipient of the next handover.
weeks.challenge: Map one end-to-end workflow. Add approval and exception branches, then produce an SOP and action list that another person can follow.
submission: workflow-map.svg: trigger, inputs, steps, outputs and exceptions
field-rules.csv: required fields, source and validation
sop.md and actions.csv: owners, dependencies and next decisions
review: The diagram includes exceptions and human handover.
Each output has a recipient and a checkable completion condition.
The SOP is consistent with the field rules and ownership.
weeks.decision: Approve the workflow scope and handover points.
weeks.reference: For finance, preserve the PDF source, prepare the register and route mismatches to the reviewer. For customer follow-up, retain a draft state. For onboarding, attach evidence to each owner’s step.

knowledgeCheck.question: A workflow diagram has only a happy path. What is missing?
knowledgeCheck.explanation: The handover must specify what happens when information is missing or a decision is needed.

weeks.title: Building AI Automations
weeks.summary: 选择发票、Excel、报价或内容任务，亲手完成输入到成果的处理流程，核对并修改结果。
weeks.summary_en: Complete an invoice, spreadsheet, quote or content workflow, then verify and revise its outputs.
weeks.output: 完整成果、操作记录与结果核对。
weeks.output_en: Complete outputs, work records and verification findings.
weeks.prep: Choose tasks relevant to your role. Use the supplied records before adapting the workflow to your own non-sensitive materials.
weeks.challenge: Use an AI assistant or Codex to produce an invoice register, spreadsheet report or customer-response draft. Compare every result with the input, correct errors and retain the complete output.
submission: completed-output/: readable register, report or draft and its source references
work-record.md: instructions, revisions and checks
exceptions.csv: omissions, conflicts and human decisions
review: Produces a complete output, not only a prompt or a screenshot of a tool.
Can trace fields and claims back to the source.
Keeps original and corrected values together.
weeks.decision: Accept the prepared output for a bounded workflow trial.
weeks.reference: The invoice packet yields one review-ready record, one GST arithmetic mismatch, one duplicate and one record missing context. The correct output is a register plus exception queue, not four approved invoices.

knowledgeCheck.question: A prepared invoice has a GST arithmetic mismatch. What should be retained?
options: The original field, expected check and review decision.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Keep source evidence and route discrepancies to the accountable reviewer.

weeks.title: Connecting Business Tools
weeks.summary: 把客户跟进、采购或入职等任务串成流程，处理表单、文件和业务工具之间的信息，保留授权、去重与人工确认。
weeks.summary_en: Connect follow-up, purchasing or onboarding tasks across forms, files and business tools, retaining authorisation, deduplication and human confirmation.
weeks.output: 连接后的工作流、授权与重复事件处理记录。
weeks.output_en: Connected workflow, consent and duplicate-event handling.
weeks.prep: Identify the forms, files, shared lists and staff decisions involved. Draw the boundary between preparing an action and executing it.
weeks.challenge: Connect intake, a shared register and a review queue. Process a duplicate event and a changed request. Keep proposed messages and access requests awaiting the right owner.
submission: connected-workflow/: input form, shared register and review queue
handover-rules.md: identities, approvals, duplicates and recovery
change-log.csv: input revision and affected decisions
review: Repeated input does not create repeated work commitments.
Changed input is visible and triggers revalidation.
The workflow does not silently send, book, pay or grant access.
weeks.reference: A repeated customer enquiry updates the existing record. A changed preferred time invalidates the old draft approval. A changed employee role invalidates the prior access decision; IT still owns provisioning.

knowledgeCheck.question: A customer changes the preferred time after a reply draft is approved. What should happen?
options: Reuse the old approval for all revisions.
Update the draft and request a new approval.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Approval applies to the content and revision that was reviewed.

weeks.title: Testing and Improving Automations
weeks.summary: 用工资、合同和收支核对练习识别缺项、冲突和计算问题，检查重复执行与人工复核成本。
weeks.summary_en: Use payroll, contract and cash-flow reviews to identify missing data, conflicts and calculation issues. Examine repeats and review costs.
weeks.output: 错误与异常清单、修订结果与成本核对。
weeks.output_en: Exception findings, revisions and cost checks.
weeks.prep: Prepare normal inputs and cases with missing data, inconsistent values, duplicates and changed rules. Define what counts as a correct result.
weeks.challenge: Run the checks, document failures and improve the workflow. Measure time spent preparing and reviewing a result; create an exception handover and monitoring checklist.
submission: acceptance.csv: input, expected result, observed result and owner
exception-log.csv: failure, correction and recheck
measurement.md: time assumptions, actual observations and limitations
review: Checks business outcomes and approvals, not only file creation.
Does not hide critical errors behind an average score.
Reports measured evidence separately from forecasts.
weeks.decision: Accept corrections or return the workflow for revision.
weeks.reference: A correct duplicate flag is a useful result, not an error to conceal. An unresolved tax status stays with finance. Onboarding is incomplete until each required owner supplies the right evidence.

knowledgeCheck.question: Nine outputs are correct and one contains an unauthorized commitment. Can the average score justify release?
options: No; the control failure needs correction and rechecking.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Critical failures cannot be averaged away.

weeks.title: The Business Case for AI
weeks.summary: 向客户角色展示工作流、核对结果和 Proposal，解释预算、范围、技术依赖与风险，回应质询并争取试点决定。
weeks.summary_en: Pitch the workflow, validation and proposal to client roles; defend budget, scope, technical dependencies and risks to seek a pilot decision.
weeks.output: Business Case、预算、范围与决定记录。
weeks.output_en: Business case, budget, scope and decision log.
weeks.prep: Prepare a short client presentation using your complete output, checks, scope and budget assumptions. Keep the evidence behind each claim openable.
weeks.challenge: Present a business case to operations, finance and IT roles. Respond to a budget cut or reduced reviewer availability. Revise scope, turnaround and responsibilities, and request a specific decision.
submission: business-case.md: problem, options, evidence, cost and recommendation
budget.csv: setup, tools, review, maintenance and sensitivity
decision-log.md: owner, conditions and changes agreed
review: Explains why the chosen approach fits the business constraint.
Includes review and maintenance effort in the proposal.
Requests a named decision and records any unresolved objection.
weeks.decision: Approve, revise or stop a bounded pilot.
weeks.reference: For the invoice case, estimate 20 hours of monthly capacity at 80% coverage and five minutes saved per accepted invoice. State assumptions. Reduced reviewer availability changes turnaround and queue design, not the need for approval.

knowledgeCheck.question: A budget forecasts twenty hours of saved effort each month. Which statement is supported?
options: Twenty hours of capacity is estimated under the stated assumptions.
The company has already received a cash saving.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: A forecast is not an observed result or cash saving.

weeks.title: AI Adoption and Business Value
weeks.summary: 完成项目展示与交接，用材料说明个人承担的调查、方案、验证和协作工作；对照目标 FDE 岗位识别需要继续补齐的能力。
weeks.summary_en: Present and hand over the project, explain your own discovery, design, validation and collaboration, and identify gaps against your target FDE role.
weeks.output: 试点建议、Adoption Plan 与交接材料。
weeks.output_en: Pilot recommendation, adoption plan and handover pack.
weeks.prep: Give a colleague the workflow, SOP, exception rules and review checklist. Note where they need additional explanation.
weeks.challenge: Complete the final presentation and a peer handover. Compare the pilot plan with the original baseline, decide what remains uncertain and recommend continue, change or stop.
submission: pilot-plan.md: users, baseline, measures and expansion decision
handover.md: setup, owners, review queue and recovery
individual-contribution.md: work performed, decisions and evidence
role-to-evidence.md: target FDE responsibilities, your individual contribution, supporting project artefacts and remaining technical gaps
review: A colleague can operate the workflow and handle a supplied exception.
Open issues have owners and next steps.
Each participant can explain their contribution and the effect of a changed condition.
Explains individual decisions with project evidence and identifies remaining technical gaps against target FDE responsibilities.
weeks.decision: Accept the handover or request specific corrections.
weeks.reference: Handover is accepted when the receiver can trace an invoice field, explain a duplicate decision, revalidate a changed customer draft and identify the HR/IT owner of an onboarding blocker. An attractive presentation alone is insufficient.

knowledgeCheck.question: A colleague cannot handle an exception without the author. What should happen before handover acceptance?
options: Accept because the author can do it.
Improve the instructions and have the receiver repeat the check.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Handover tests whether another person can operate the workflow with the materials.

A budget forecasts twenty hours of saved effort each month. Which statement is supported?

  • Twenty hours of capacity is estimated under the stated assumptions.
  • Twenty hours is guaranteed.
  • The company has already received a cash saving.
Answer and reasoning

Twenty hours of capacity is estimated under the stated assumptions.

A forecast is not an observed result or cash saving.

For the invoice case, estimate 20 hours of monthly capacity at 80% coverage and five minutes saved per accepted invoice. State assumptions. Reduced reviewer availability changes turnaround and queue design, not the need for approval.

schedule.title: Business 的 8 周，怎样一步步推进？
schedule.intro: 8 周从已有业务经验出发，补 AI 技术理解与自动化实践，再把调查、方案、Pitch 和交接组织成完整的 FDE 项目材料。

stages.title: Business Problems and AI Opportunities
stages.activity: 调查部门目标与重复工作。用市场调研练习核对资料与判断依据，确定值得改进的流程。
stages.output: 问题定义、流程与机会优先级。

stages.title: AI Fluency for Decision-Makers
stages.activity: 判断 AI、规则与人工各承担什么。先理解资料处理、工具操作、权限和人工复核的边界。
stages.output: 能力边界、人工决策点与验证计划。

stages.title: Designing AI Workflows
stages.activity: 从邮件、PDF 和 SOP 任务出发，画出输入、处理、输出、审批与异常路径。
stages.output: Workflow Map、输入输出规则与审批设计。

stages.title: Building AI Automations
stages.activity: 选择发票、Excel、报价或内容任务，亲手完成输入到成果的处理流程，核对并修改结果。
stages.output: 完整成果、操作记录与结果核对。

stages.title: Connecting Business Tools
stages.activity: 把客户跟进、采购或入职等任务串成流程，处理表单、文件和业务工具之间的信息，保留授权、去重与人工确认。
stages.output: 连接后的工作流、授权与重复事件处理记录。

stages.title: Testing and Improving Automations
stages.activity: 用工资、合同和收支核对练习识别缺项、冲突和计算问题，检查重复执行与人工复核成本。
stages.output: 错误与异常清单、修订结果与成本核对。

stages.title: The Business Case for AI
stages.activity: 展示已完成的工作流和核对结果，说明价值、预算、实施依赖与风险，回应不同部门的质询。
stages.output: Business Case、预算、范围与决定记录。

stages.title: AI Adoption and Business Value
stages.activity: 整理使用说明、责任与交接材料，用试点结果判断是否继续投入，并完成最终展示。
stages.output: 试点建议、Adoption Plan 与交接材料。

schedule.note: 按 8 周规划。开课日期、每周具体课时与上课时段，报名时确认。

automation.title: 30 项 AI 自动化任务，从你的日常工作练起
automation.intro: 30 项企业自动化任务，用来补业务背景学员的 AI 动手能力。按案例选择任务，核对结果、解释技术限制，再把工作流放进客户 Proposal、预算和交付计划。
automation.roleNote: 你不需要先把所有工具学一遍。先选自己熟悉的业务任务，亲手做出结果，再把相关任务连起来，练习如何向同事和技术团队说明需求、处理异常、核算投入。

items.title: 澳洲发票提取与GST核对
items.goal: 把不同格式的发票整理成统一台账，核对金额、GST 和缺失字段，找出需要人工确认的地方。

items.title: PDF 转换与结构整理
items.goal: 把 PDF 中的业务资料整理成可编辑文档、流程表和行动清单，方便继续处理和交接。

items.title: Excel 自动化处理
items.goal: 清洗订单、统一字段、生成汇总报表，把重复的 Excel 工作变成可以复用的处理流程。

items.title: 邮件整理
items.goal: 从往来邮件中分出轻重缓急，提取待办、负责人和时间，再起草有依据的回复。

items.title: 网页填表
items.goal: 把已有业务资料映射到表单字段，检查缺项和格式，减少反复复制、粘贴和返工。

items.title: 报价单制作
items.goal: 根据服务项目和费用规则制作报价单，把范围、金额和待确认条件一起说清楚。

items.title: 工资核对
items.goal: 对照工时与工资资料，找出金额差异和缺失记录，整理成可交给负责人核查的清单。

items.title: 录音成文
items.goal: 把会议录音与笔记整理成摘要、决定和行动项，区分已经确认的事项与仍需追问的问题。

items.title: 市场与竞品调研
items.goal: 整理市场与竞品资料，保留信息来源，做出能支持业务判断的比较表。

items.title: SOP 制作
items.goal: 把零散的操作经验写成 SOP，补上负责人、检查点和出错后该怎么处理。

items.title: 合同阅读
items.goal: 从合同中整理关键日期、金额和责任条款，列出需要向业务或专业人士确认的问题。

items.title: 收支追踪
items.goal: 把分散的收支记录整理成汇总表，追踪余额变化，发现重复、缺项和异常金额。

items.title: 宣传图制作与修改
items.goal: 根据活动或产品需求制作宣传图，再按反馈修改，检查文字、品牌与内容是否一致。

items.title: 文件批量整理
items.goal: 批量整理杂乱文件，建立分类、命名和索引，让同事也能找到、看懂和接着用。

items.title: 客户资料整理
items.goal: 合并客户资料、识别重复记录，整理联系授权与跟进事项，避免重复联系和遗漏。

items.title: 定时工作任务
items.goal: 把已经验证的重复任务安排成周期流程，考虑重复执行、失败提醒和人工检查。

items.title: 视频号策划
items.goal: 把活动与产品资料整理成短视频选题、脚本和分镜，让内容制作有清楚的依据。

items.title: 小红书创作
items.goal: 把已有业务资料写成图文文案和逐页内容，检查信息、语气和发布前需要确认的事项。

items.title: 销售线索接收与跟进
items.goal: 把不同渠道的询盘整理到跟进队列，识别缺失信息、退出联系和重复线索，准备下一步沟通。

items.title: 客服分流与人工升级
items.goal: 把常见咨询、资料不全和需要升级的问题分开处理，起草回复，让退款等决定交给负责人。

items.title: 采购申请与审批
items.goal: 把采购需求、报价、费用和审批人串成流程，识别超预算与缺资料的申请，整理审批材料。

items.title: 供应商方案比较
items.goal: 比较供应商的价格、服务与硬性要求，保留未知项，说明推荐理由和还需要问清楚的条件。

items.title: 员工报销核对与异常
items.goal: 对照报销申请和凭证，找出金额差异、缺失单据与重复提交，准备待审批清单。

items.title: 面试安排与协调
items.goal: 核对面试时间、时区和面试官安排，处理冲突、补齐信息，再准备邀请与协调消息。

items.title: 员工入职任务与责任交接
items.goal: 把入职准备拆成有负责人和先后顺序的任务，跟进资料、权限审批与跨部门交接。

items.title: 会议记录到行动计划
items.goal: 把会议中的讨论转成可跟进的行动计划，分清建议与决定，补齐负责人和截止时间。

items.title: 项目周报与决策简报
items.goal: 从项目更新中整理进展依据、阻碍与需要拍板的问题，写出能帮助负责人做决定的周报。

items.title: 库存检查与补货建议
items.goal: 核对库存、预留数量和数据时效，计算补货建议，说明数量依据并保留审批环节。

items.title: 资料请求与权限审批
items.goal: 判断资料请求该走公开回复、补充用途还是权限审批，把申请交到正确的负责人手里。

items.title: 工作流监测与人工接管
items.goal: 检查运行失败、重复执行与费用超限，在结果不明确时先核对，再决定重试或人工接管。

faqs.q: 业务、产品或咨询背景，没有 AI Engineering 经验可以参加吗？
faqs.a: 可以从已有业务经验开始，课程会练 AI 能力边界、自动化工作流、结果验证与客户方案。你需要亲自完成实践。目标岗位如果要求独立开发、系统接入和生产运维，还需要继续补齐 AI Engineering；选课时先对照目标岗位要求。

faqs.q: 这门课怎样帮助我准备转行做 FDE？
faqs.a: 用多个案例练客户调查、方案比较、预算、工作流验证和 Pitch，并保留个人贡献、评审修改与交接材料。你可以据此解释自己具备哪些交付能力，再对照目标岗位补强；课程不承诺录用或薪资结果。

faqs.q: 正价、首期预购和早鸟有什么区别？
faqs.a: 正价 A$3,850；首期预购 A$3,500，比正价少 A$350；早鸟 A$3,650，比正价少 A$200。三档对应同一门 8 周课程，按报名阶段适用；具体阶段时间咨询确认。

faqs.q: 要学多久，工作之余能安排吗？
faqs.a: Business 按 8 周规划，围绕多个案例做任务、准备方案并进行展示。具体开课日期、每周课时和上课时段，在报名前确认。

faqs.q: Business 和 Tech，主要差在哪里？
faqs.a: 两门课都围绕 FDE 职责训练。Business 从业务、产品与咨询经验出发，补 AI 技术理解、自动化实践、方案与客户交付；Tech 以独立开发 AI 应用为起点，深入工程接入、评估、可靠性与运行。按当前能力和目标岗位选课，两门课独立报名。

cases.title: ANZ · Z-GPT：银行内部知识怎样接给 AI？
cases.text: 内部资料、回答可靠性和人工责任，需要放在同一个交付方案里考虑。
cases.problem: 如果接手一个类似的银行内部助手，怎样确定可接入的资料、身份边界与回答验收要求？
cases.decision: 课堂从范围可控的内部问答切入，核对来源、权限与人工责任，再讨论是否值得扩展。
cases.tradeoff: 比较现成企业工具、检索问答与定制集成。把资料治理、接入、评估和使用培训都计入投入。
cases.change: 训练条件：一个资料库未获安全批准。重新提出试点范围与预算建议，争取客户决定。
cases.output: 资料负责人和访问边界、分阶段立项建议、预算与验收口径，以及技术团队接入清单。
cases.facts: ANZ 在 2023 年介绍了内部聊天工具 Z-GPT：通过 Microsoft 使用 OpenAI 模型，围绕部分内部数据开展实验，并强调使用者需要审查回答、对最终决定负责。

cases.title: Woolworths · Olive：从问答到购物动作
cases.text: 能推荐商品以后，还要界定哪些动作由助手做、哪些必须由用户确认。
cases.problem: 当助手从回答问题变成添加商品，怎样设计用户控制、商品数据和工具执行之间的边界？
cases.decision: 课堂把建议、加入购物篮和结账分开。商品信息以业务系统为准；修改购物篮可撤回，结账由用户完成。
cases.tradeoff: 先验证一段完整的购物流程，再讨论个性化。分别估算商品接入、工具执行、评估和人工支持成本。
cases.change: 训练条件：价格或库存接口不稳定。决定哪些功能应降级、暂停，哪些仍能保留。
cases.output: 购物流程与动作边界、价值与成本比较、原型验证记录，以及业务、产品和技术团队的上线决定。
cases.facts: Woolworths 的 Olive 官方页面介绍了餐食灵感、购物篮建议和添加商品功能；最终结账由用户完成。购物助手与客服助手分开，完整历史订单访问仍未开放。

cases.title: IAG · CASI：理赔团队怎样用 AI 查保单？
cases.text: 找到保单段落只是开始，还要让员工能够核对依据、理解适用范围。
cases.problem: 如果为类似的理赔团队设计保单助手，怎样让员工核对条款、版本与适用条件，而不是直接相信一段回答？
cases.decision: 课堂围绕有引用的保单问答设计流程，区分资料检索、条款解释与最终理赔决定。
cases.tradeoff: 优先支持范围明确的产品与保单版本。把回答复核和资料更新成本纳入价值判断。
cases.change: 训练条件：新旧保单版本同时存在且答案冲突。调整检索、审核和交接安排，再说明扩大试点的条件。
cases.output: 理赔员工工作流、条款与人工决定边界、核对记录，以及包含复核与资料更新成本的试点建议。
cases.facts: IAG 在 2024 年年报中介绍 CASI，用于帮助员工查找保单文件、判断相关保障内容，提高服务效率。

cases.title: ANZ · Z-GPT: connecting internal bank knowledge
cases.text: Internal data, answer reliability and human accountability belong in the same delivery plan.
cases.problem: For a comparable bank assistant, how would you define source access, identity boundaries and answer acceptance criteria?
cases.decision: Start the classroom design with bounded internal Q&A, source checks and human responsibility before considering expansion.
cases.tradeoff: Compare existing enterprise tools, retrieval and custom integrations. Include data governance, integration, evaluation and adoption effort.
cases.change: Training condition: security rejects a source. Revise the pilot scope and budget recommendation for the sponsor.
cases.output: Data ownership and access boundaries, a phased business case, budget and acceptance criteria, and an engineering integration brief.
cases.facts: ANZ described Z-GPT in 2023: an internal chatbot using OpenAI models through Microsoft, with experiments on subsets of internal data. Users were responsible for reviewing answers and making the final decision.

cases.title: Woolworths · Olive: from answers to shopping actions
cases.text: Once an assistant can act, define which steps it may take and which the customer controls.
cases.problem: When an assistant can add products, how do you separate customer control, product data and tool execution?
cases.decision: Separate suggestions, basket changes and checkout. Ground product details in business systems; make basket changes reversible and leave checkout to the user.
cases.tradeoff: Validate one complete shopping flow before adding personalisation. Estimate product integration, tool execution, evaluation and support costs separately.
cases.change: Training condition: pricing or stock APIs become unreliable. Decide which actions to degrade, pause or retain.
cases.output: A shopping workflow, action boundaries, value and cost comparison, prototype findings, and cross-team launch decisions.
cases.facts: The official Olive page describes meal inspiration, basket suggestions and adding items. Users complete checkout themselves. Shopping and support assistants are separate; full order-history access is not yet available.

cases.title: IAG · CASI: policy information for claims teams
cases.text: Finding a policy passage is only useful when staff can verify its source and applicability.
cases.problem: For a comparable claims assistant, how would staff verify clauses, versions and applicability rather than simply trust an answer?
cases.decision: Design cited policy Q&A and distinguish retrieval, interpretation and the final claims decision.
cases.tradeoff: Start with clearly scoped products and policy versions. Include answer review and document maintenance in the value calculation.
cases.change: Training condition: old and new policies produce conflicting answers. Revise retrieval, review and handover before recommending expansion.
cases.output: Claims workflows, policy and human-decision boundaries, verification findings, and a pilot recommendation that includes review and update costs.
cases.facts: IAG’s 2024 annual report describes CASI as an AI chatbot helping employees identify policy documents and relevant coverage to serve customers more efficiently.
